title: ProjectE ngspice simulation acceptance report
description: Rail voltage-drop and AC band acceptance measured from a real ngspice batch run.

design.description: The artifact this report measured (board, netlist or request file), with its digest. REQUIRED: an untieable report is SCREEN_ONLY however good the number in it is.

metrics.description: check name -> violation count. `checks` is a list and the assertion selector grammar addresses a.b paths; this map is how a rule points at one check.

by_check.description: check name -> {status, scanned, violations}. The name-keyed map that carries COVERAGE, which `metrics` cannot. These are the two halves of one fix and they point in opposite directions: `metrics` is null for an unmeasured check so a threshold comparison CANNOT falsely succeed, and `by_check` lets a rule affirmatively assert that the check ran - `by_check.X.status equals PASS` means ran + examined something + clean, because Finding refuses to build a scanned==0 PASS. Null alone turns a vacuous PASS into a type error, which reads as a broken rule rather than an empty check; by_check alone would leave existing metrics.* bindings comparing 0 to 0. NOTE the denominator is only as honest as the producer: `scanned` must be the population the check actually examined, not a larger set that happens to be non-empty.

$comment: If ngspice is absent NO number is invented: every check reports NO_COVERAGE. A simulation report with a made-up number is worse than no report, because it looks like a PASS.
